== Notes ==
* Combines well with skills that draw conditions to you, such as [[Foul Feast]].
* This spell won't [[fail]] if your target dies while you are casting it, resulting in removal of conditions and health still being sacrificed.

== Trivia ==
* This was an [[elite skill]] in the Prophecies beta testing.
